pageProps.title: Linux DRM - Sharing Buffers with PRIME and dma-buf
pageProps.review: Explains how to share buffers between processes and devices using Linux DRM PRIME and dma-buf. Tracing handle→fd export, fd→handle import, and device reuse branches like dma_buf_ops using Linux v6.19 code.
pageProps.description: How Linux DRM shares buffers between processes and devices with PRIME and dma-buf: handle to fd export, fd to handle import, the dma_buf_ops table, and a dumb buffer plus PRIME example.
